script: [excited gasp] Gerald has brought a pile of presents! Tap a box to open it, then touch each toy to count. Here we go!
[rustling paper, delighted giggle] Ooh! Just one little duck. Touch him and count with me.
Touch the duck. How many ducks are in the box?
[happy gasp] Teddy bears! Touch one, then the other, and count them out loud.
Touch each teddy. How many teddies?
[bouncy laugh] Balls! Bouncy, bouncy balls. Touch every single one as you count.
Touch each ball. How many balls are there?
[car noises, giggles] Brrrm! Little cars. Touch them one at a time — do not miss one!
Touch each car. How many cars?
[gasp, then a slurp] Cupcakes! Yum. Let us count every one before we eat them.
Touch each cupcake. How many cupcakes?
[drum roll, laughs] Boom, boom! Look at all these drums. Touch each one and count.
Touch each drum. How many drums?
[soft, magical whisper] Look up! The wishing stars are out. Touch them in counting order and your wish will come true.
[whispers] Three little stars are twinkling. Start at one.
Touch star one, then two, then three.
[twinkling giggle] Four stars now, and they are hiding all over the sky!
Find one, two, three, four — in order!
[amazed] Five wishing stars! Read the number on each one before you touch it.
Touch them one, two, three, four, five.
[playful] These ones are being cheeky and hiding. Look carefully at the numbers!
Which star says one? Start there.
[cheerful] Time to write our numbers! Put your finger on the big green dot and follow the dashes. I will help you.
[softly] Zero! Zero means none at all. Start at the top and go all the way round.
Trace zero. Round and round, back to the top.
[bright] Number one! One is easy — a little slide down, then straight down.
Trace the number one. Down, down, down!
[playful] Number two! Around like a swan, then slide down and across the water.
Trace the number two. Around, down, and across!
[giggles] Number three! Two little tummies, one on top of the other.
Trace three. Around the top, around the bottom!
[counting rhythm] Number four! Down, across… then lift your finger and go down again.
Trace four. Down, across, lift, down!
[bright] Number five! Down the back, round the big tummy, then a hat on top.
Trace five. Down, around, and a hat!
[whispers] Shhh… the Yippies are all fast asleep. [comic snore] We need to wake up just the right number. Poke them gently!
[very quiet] Start with just one Yippie. One little poke!
Wake up one Yippie, then ring the bell.
[whispering] Two Yippies are wanted for breakfast. Just two!
Wake up two Yippies, then ring the bell.
[whispering, giggling] Three Yippies are going out to play. Only three!
Wake up three Yippies, then ring the bell.
[excited whisper] Four Yippies for the band! Count as you poke.
Wake up four Yippies, then ring the bell.
[whispering] Five Yippies are going swimming. Careful — that is nearly all of them!
Wake up five Yippies, then ring the bell.
[laughs] Breakfast is ready! This time wake up every single one.
Wake up six Yippies, then ring the bell.
[urgent, playful] Oh no! The kittens are stuck in cages. [meow] Look quickly, say how many, and the door pops open!
[playful] Start with two dots. Quick eyes!
How many dots?
[quick and bright] Quick eyes ready? Do not count — just look!
How many dots? Say it fast!
[giggles] These dots are all over the place. Look at the whole picture.
How many dots?
[excited] Ooh, this one is bigger. Just look at the shape!
How many dots? Quick!
[amazed] Two rows of three! Can you see it without counting?
How many dots altogether?
[encouraging] Bigger now. Try five and two more.
How many dots?
[bright] Four and four. Look at the two rows!
How many dots?
[cheering] The last kitten! Five on top, five below.
How many dots? Set that kitten free!
[cheerful ribbit] This is Hoppy! She wants to cross the river, but she can only jump to the pad that is ONE MORE. Will you help her?
[ribbit] Hoppy is on pad one. One more than one is…?
Which pad is one more than one?
[splashing giggle] Now she is on two. Count on: two… then?
Which pad is one more than two?
[ribbit] Pad three! What comes straight after three?
Which pad is one more than three?
[encouraging] Four. Say the next number in the count.
Which pad is one more than four?
[excited] Halfway! One more than five is…?
Which pad is one more than five?
[ribbit ribbit] Six. Keep counting on!
Which pad is one more than six?
[whispers] Nearly there. One more than seven!
Which pad is one more than seven?
[cheering] Last jump! One more than eight and she is home!
Which pad is one more than eight?
[rocket rumble, excited] The rocket is ready to blast off! But the countdown has a number missing. Can you fix it?
[whispers] Five, four, three… and then?
What comes after three when we count back?
[counting backwards] Eight… hmm, then six. Something is missing!
Which number goes between eight and six?
[counting] Ten, nine… oh no, what comes next?
Which number is missing? Ten, nine, what, seven?
[rocket engine hum] Seven, six… quick, the number is missing!
Which number is missing? Seven, six, what, four?
[playful] We are counting down to blast off. What do we start on?
Which number comes before three?
[deep countdown voice] Ten… something… eight, seven!
Which number goes between ten and eight?
[echoing whisper] It is dark in here! [gasp] Look — glowing orbs. If we put both piles together the cave lights up. Tap the piles!
[echo] Two orbs here… and one over there.
Put them together. How many orbs altogether?
[echo, excited] Three orbs and two orbs! Count them all.
How many orbs altogether?
[whispers] Four glowing orbs, and one little one.
How many orbs altogether?
[amazed] Three and three! Both piles are the same.
How many orbs altogether?
[echo] Five here, two there. Start at five and count on.
How many orbs altogether?
[cheering echo] Four and four — the brightest one yet!
How many orbs altogether?
[bright] Here is our ten frame — ten little boxes. Drop in the blue stones first, then the yellow ones, and see what we get!
[cheerful] Put in three blue stones… then two yellow ones.
How many stones are in the frame altogether?
[happy] Five blue fills the whole top row. Then just one yellow.
How many stones altogether?
[bright] Four blue, then three yellow. Fill the top row first!
How many stones altogether?
[playful] Only two blue this time — but six yellow!
How many stones altogether?
[encouraging] Seven blue. That is more than a row! Then two yellow.
How many stones altogether?
[excited gasp] Five and five — I think this one fills every box!
How many stones altogether?
[curious] Let us play a looking game! Some things are ABOVE, some are ON, and some are hiding UNDER. Listen carefully!
[playful] Look at the table. A balloon, an apple and a sleepy cat.
Tap the thing that is ABOVE the table.
[giggles] Someone is hiding down low. Have a look!
Tap the thing that is UNDER the table.
[bright] Here is a shelf. Something is sitting right on top of it.
Tap the thing that is ON the shelf.
[wind sound, laughs] A kite up in the sky, a chick on the box, and a mouse under it!
Tap the thing that is ABOVE the box.
[whispers] Where did that ball roll to? Look down low!
Tap the thing that is UNDER the chair.
[soft] Night time! The moon is up, the plant is resting, the boots are put away.
Tap the thing that is ON the shelf.
[excited] Welcome to the monster picnic! Two groups of little monsters are joining the party. Count them all, then tap the answer!
[cheers] Yes! You counted the monsters! Fantastic!
[warmly] Let's count the little monsters again. Have another go!
[happy laugh] Hooray! You finished the monster challenge. You are a maths star!
1 monster is here. 1 more joins in. What is 1 plus 1? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
2 monsters are here. 1 more joins them. What is 2 plus 1? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
2 monsters are here. 2 more join them. What is 2 plus 2? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
3 monsters are here. 2 more join them. What is 3 plus 2? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
4 monsters are here. 2 more join them. What is 4 plus 2? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
3 monsters are here. 4 more join them. What is 3 plus 4? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
5 monsters are here. 3 more join them. What is 5 plus 3? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
5 monsters are here. 5 more join them. What is 5 plus 5? Tap how many monsters there are altogether.
[playful] Welcome to the monster hide-and-seek! Some monsters hide. Count the monsters still here, then tap the answer!
[cheers] Yes! You counted the monsters! Fantastic!
[warmly] Let's count the little monsters again. Have another go!
[happy laugh] Hooray! You finished the monster challenge. You are a maths star!
2 monsters are here. 1 hides. What is 2 take away 1? Tap how many monsters are left.
3 monsters are here. 1 hides. What is 3 take away 1? Tap how many monsters are left.
4 monsters are here. 2 hide. What is 4 take away 2? Tap how many monsters are left.
5 monsters are here. 2 hide. What is 5 take away 2? Tap how many monsters are left.
5 monsters are here. 5 hide. What is 5 take away 5? Tap how many monsters are left.
7 monsters are here. 3 hide. What is 7 take away 3? Tap how many monsters are left.
8 monsters are here. 2 hide. What is 8 take away 2? Tap how many monsters are left.
10 monsters are here. 3 hide. What is 10 take away 3? Tap how many monsters are left.
A is for apple! [giggles] Let's practise the /a/ sound together. Open your mouth wide and say, ah-ah-apple!
Which letter says /a/? [whispers] Listen closely… ah, ah, ah. Can you spot it?
B is for ball! [boing sound] Pop your lips together like this — buh! Now bounce it with me: buh-buh-ball!
Which letter says /b/? [taps softly] Buh, buh, buh — point to the one that pops!
C is for cat! [playful meow, then giggles] The /k/ sound hides right at the back of your throat. Ready? kuh-kuh-cat!
Which letter says /k/? [whispers] Kuh, kuh, kuh. Which letter is hiding it?
D is for dog! [happy bark, laughs] Tap your tongue behind your top teeth — duh! Say it with me: duh-duh-dog!
Which letter says /d/? [giggles] Duh, duh, duh — tap the right one!
E is for egg! [gasps] Careful — don't drop it! [giggles] Smile a little and say, eh-eh-egg!
Which letter says /e/? [whispers] Eh, eh, eh. Show me where it is!
F is for fish! [blows bubbles] Put your top teeth on your bottom lip and blow — fff! Now: fff-fff-fish!
Which letter says /f/? [blows softly] Fff, fff, fff — can you find it?
G is for goat! [laughs] Oh no, that goat is nibbling my hat! Growl it from your throat: guh-guh-goat!
Which letter says /g/? [playful growl] Guh, guh, guh. Which one is it?
H is for hat! [giggles] Breathe warm air onto your hands — hhh! Then say it with me: hhh-hhh-hat!
Which letter says /h/? [breathes out] Hhh, hhh, hhh — point to it!
I is for insect! [tiny buzzing, then giggles] It's tickling my nose! Keep it short and quick: ih-ih-insect!
Which letter says /i/? [tiny buzz] Ih, ih, ih. Where is it hiding?
J is for juice! [slurping sound] Mmm, yummy! [laughs] Push the sound out with your lips: juh-juh-juice!
Which letter says /j/? [giggles] Juh, juh, juh — which letter shall we pick?
K is for kite! [whoosh] Up, up, up it goes into the sky! Say it with me: kuh-kuh-kite!
Which letter says /k/? [whoosh] Kuh, kuh, kuh. Show me!
L is for lion! [big roar, then giggles] Don't worry, he's a friendly one. Lift your tongue up high: lll-lll-lion!
Which letter says /l/? [soft roar] Lll, lll, lll — can you see it?
M is for moon! [yawns] It's sleepy time way up there. Close your lips and hum with me: mmm-mmm-moon!
Which letter says /m/? [hums] Mmm, mmm, mmm. Which one is it?
N is for nose! [pretend sneeze, then laughs] Bless you! Tongue up, and hum through your nose: nnn-nnn-nose!
Which letter says /n/? [hums through nose] Nnn, nnn, nnn — point to the right one!
O is for orange! [giggles] Make your mouth into a big round O, just like the fruit: oh-oh-orange!
Which letter says /o/? [whispers] Oh, oh, oh. Which letter is round like your mouth?
P is for pig! [oink oink, laughs] Puff the air right off your lips — puh! Now: puh-puh-pig!
Which letter says /p/? [puffs] Puh, puh, puh — find it for me!
Q is for queen! [trumpet fanfare, then giggles] Q always brings her friend U along. Say it royally: kwuh-kwuh-queen!
Which letter says /kw/? [tiny fanfare] Kwuh, kwuh, kwuh. Where's the royal one?
R is for rain! [pitter-patter sounds] Splish, splash! Curl your tongue back and rumble: rrr-rrr-rain!
Which letter says /r/? [rumbles] Rrr, rrr, rrr — can you hear which one?
S is for sun! [giggles] Hide your tongue behind your teeth and hiss like a little snake: sss-sss-sun!
Which letter says /s/? [hisses softly] Sss, sss, sss. Point to the snake sound!
T is for tree! [tick-tock sound] Tap your tongue quick and light: tuh-tuh-tree!
Which letter says /t/? [tap tap] Tuh, tuh, tuh — which letter is it?
U is for umbrella! [rain drops, then laughs] Up it goes — now we're dry! Short and soft: uh-uh-umbrella!
Which letter says /u/? [whispers] Uh, uh, uh. Show me the one!
V is for van! [engine vroom, giggles] Buzz your lip and your teeth together: vvv-vvv-van!
Which letter says /v/? [buzzes] Vvv, vvv, vvv — which letter drives the van?
W is for water! [splash, then laughs] Oops, you got me! Round your lips like a kiss: wuh-wuh-water!
Which letter says /w/? [giggles] Wuh, wuh, wuh. Which one is it?
X is for fox! [sly giggle] Now here's a secret — X likes to sit at the *end* of the word. Listen closely: fo-ks, ks-ks-fox!
Which letter makes the /ks/ sound at the end? [whispers] Ks, ks, ks — find it!
Y is for yoyo! [whee! then giggles] Down it goes and up it comes! Stretch your tongue: yuh-yuh-yoyo!
Which letter says /y/? [whee] Yuh, yuh, yuh. Can you point to it?
Z is for zebra! [buzzes like a bee, then laughs] Buzz it with your voice switched on: zzz-zzz-zebra!
Which letter says /z/? [buzzes like a bee] Zzz, zzz, zzz — which one is buzzing?
Look, a cat! [playful meow, giggles] Words that rhyme sound the same at the end. Listen: cat… hat. Can you hear it?
Which one rhymes with cat? [whispers] Cat… caaat. Find the one that matches!
Here comes a dog! [happy bark, laughs] Now listen to the ending: dog… frog. They sound the same!
Which one rhymes with dog? [whispers] Dog… ogg, ogg. Which one hops along?
The sun is shining! [giggles] Sun… bun. Ooh, that makes me hungry! Listen to the ending sound.
Which one rhymes with sun? [whispers] Sun… un, un, un. Which one is it?
A busy little bee! [buzzing, then giggles] Bee… tree. Both end with that long eee sound!
Which one rhymes with bee? [whispers] Bee… eee, eee. Point to it!
Twinkle, twinkle, little star! [sings softly, giggles] Star… car. Listen to that arr at the end!
Which one rhymes with star? [whispers] Star… arr, arr. Which one drives away?
A tiny mouse! [squeaks, then laughs] Where does he live? Mouse… house! They rhyme beautifully.
Which one rhymes with mouse? [whispers] Mouse… ouse, ouse. Can you find it?
Sssss, a snake! [playful hiss, giggles] Snake… cake. Now that is a rhyme worth eating!
Which one rhymes with snake? [whispers] Snake… ake, ake. Which one is yummy?
A hungry goat! [laughs] Goat… boat. Imagine a goat sailing a boat! [giggles] Listen to the ending.
Which one rhymes with goat? [whispers] Goat… oat, oat. Which one floats?
Bounce, bounce, a ball! [boing sound, giggles] Ball… wall. Careful where you kick it!
Which one rhymes with ball? [whispers] Ball… all, all. Point to the right one!
A sneaky fox! [sly giggle] Where is he hiding? Fox… box! Those endings sound just the same.
Which one rhymes with fox? [whispers] Fox… ox, ox. Which one can he hide in?
[excited] Welcome, word spotter! Sight words are words we learn to know in a snap. Listen, look at the sentence, and tap the missing word!
[brightly] The. The cat is sleeping. Which word is the?
[playfully] I. I can jump. Which word is I?
[with energy] Can. The bird can fly. Which word is can?
[amazed] See. I see a rainbow. Which word is see?
[happily] Like. I like apples. Which word is like?
[warmly] My. This is my teddy. Which word is my?
[cheerfully] We. We play together. Which word is we?
[excited] Go. Let us go home. Which word is go?
[excited] Welcome, sound blender! Listen to three letter sounds, push them together, and tap the word they make!
[rhythmically] C, a, t. Push the sounds together: cat! Which one is cat?
[rhythmically] D, o, g. Push the sounds together: dog! Which one is dog?
[rhythmically] P, i, g. Push the sounds together: pig! Which one is pig?
[rhythmically] S, u, n. Push the sounds together: sun! Which one is sun?
[rhythmically] H, e, n. Push the sounds together: hen! Which one is hen?
[rhythmically] C, u, p. Push the sounds together: cup! Which one is cup?
[rhythmically] M, a, p. Push the sounds together: map! Which one is map?
[rhythmically] B, e, d. Push the sounds together: bed! Which one is bed?
[claps and laughs] Yes! You did it! That's the one!
[cheers] Woo-hoo! You are a super sound finder!
[giggles] Brilliant! Your listening ears are working perfectly!
[happy gasp] Wow! That is exactly right! High five!
[laughs] Yes, yes, yes! You are getting so good at this!
[gentle giggle] Ooh, not that one. Have a listen again — you can do it!
[warmly] So close! Let's use our listening ears one more time.
[playful hmm] Hmm, that one sounds different. Try again!
[encouraging] Nearly there, my friend. Have another go!
[soft chuckle] Oops! No problem at all. Let's try once more!
[cheers and claps] Hooray! You finished them all! [giggles] You are a reading star. Shall we play again?
